svg.title: What Omanotch handles
svg.desc: Animated loop of a MacBook running Omarchy full screen, with the Omarchy bar in the strip beside the camera notch. It cycles through: a notification appearing just below the strip; a theme switch where the bar changes colour smoothly; the bar hidden so the wallpaper runs through the strip behind the notch; a full-screen video with the strip turning black; the lock screen with its password field below the strip; the laptop morphing between 16, 14 and 13 inch sizes while the bar's gap stays aligned with the notch; and a swipe to another macOS Space, with the strip travelling along with the VM.
